item.description: AI agents now carry more access and more connections to enterprise systems than any other software in the environment. item.description: AI is evolving beyond a helpful tool to an autonomous agent, creating new risks for cybersecurity systems. item.description: Most people don’t appreciate the profound threat that AI will soon pose to human agency.
